gemma26_text_constrained_minus_base_text.caveat: Cross-model comparisons change the complete model bundle: model weights and architecture, tokenizer/chat-template, quantization and any model-local custom loader. The staged gemma26_ollama bundle uses Ollama NVFP4 weights and a custom MLX loader; the alternative Hugging Face mlx-community bundle uses 4-bit affine weights with 8-bit router projections. The E4B control is BF16. Read each arm model path and bundle provenance to identify the actual implementation. Gemma26 and E4B chat templates may also differ in empty-thought-channel prefilling. Differences cannot be attributed to parameter count alone.

limitations: Only complete matched-cohort arms enter comparisons; incomplete teacher action sets excluded equally.
Validity is single-attempt generation; max_retries config is not used in probe mode.
Regret is against privileged continuation-policy values, not optimal-action truth.
Regret given valid excludes malformed choices and is selection biased; read validity beside it.
Pairwise intervals use world means across states valid under both arms; descriptive exploratory comparisons.
